obligations.subject: VDD admission result
obligations.trigger: Before the first semantic worker of create or explicit recovery
obligations.state_before: Admission checks are split across source, recovery, dependency and consumer stages
obligations.state_after: A bounded non-authorizing admission result lists readable sources, the explicitly selected recovery candidate, available dependency projection and the actual Quick Dev public entry
obligations.expected_behavior: Provide one bounded admission result before semantic workers using only the current inputs available at admission
obligations.observable_result: The public compiler returns the four named check outcomes before a worker can start
forbidden_result: Starting a semantic worker before admission

obligations.subject: Independent profile validation
obligations.trigger: Admission receives a VDD plan-shape and Quick Dev execution profile
obligations.state_after: Both profiles are validated independently under their existing policies
obligations.expected_behavior: Validate each profile against its owning policy without treating the VDD plan-shape as the execution profile
obligations.observable_result: A valid pair succeeds independently; an invalid member is diagnosed in its own domain

obligations.subject: Admission model route preservation
obligations.state_before: The caller already has a model route
obligations.state_after: No model is inferred and current model routing is unchanged
obligations.expected_behavior: Do not infer a model or change model routing during admission
obligations.observable_result: Recorded current route remains unchanged and admission makes no routing mutation

obligations.subject: Read-only admission effects
obligations.trigger: Admission inspects valid, invalid or pending inputs
obligations.state_before: Repository and native cache/run state have fixed bytes
obligations.state_after: Admission returns diagnostics without model calls, test execution, run-state creation, plan publication or cache mutation
obligations.expected_behavior: Perform admission without the listed model, execution and filesystem side effects
obligations.observable_result: Instrumented public admission shows no model/test calls and unchanged run, publication and cache bytes

obligations.subject: Required current-input rejection
obligations.trigger: Admission encounters a missing or corrupt current input, an explicit stale or corrupt recovery candidate, or an unavailable Quick Dev public entry
obligations.state_before: Required admission input cannot be validated
obligations.state_after: Admission blocks before a worker starts
obligations.expected_behavior: Fail closed for the complete named invalid-current-input family
obligations.observable_result: Each parameterized defect returns a blocking admission diagnostic before any worker
forbidden_result: Proceeding on missing or corrupt current inputs

obligations.subject: Pending future contracts
obligations.trigger: A fresh compilation has no V3 execution contracts yet
obligations.state_after: Admission explicitly reports future contracts as pending without readiness authority
obligations.expected_behavior: Distinguish pending future contracts from successful end-to-end validation and plan readiness
obligations.observable_result: Public result labels unavailable future contracts pending and grants no plan-ready authority
forbidden_result: Reporting end-to-end validation or plan readiness before contracts exist

obligations.subject: Existing owning admission and final gates
obligations.trigger: Admission is connected to the VDD public compiler
obligations.state_before: Native source, recovery, dependency and consumer checks and later V3/final gates exist
obligations.state_after: Admission reuses owning checks and V3 execution preflight and final publication gates still run when their stages are reached
obligations.expected_behavior: Reuse current source preflight, native recovery validation, dependency rules and consumer checks; retain mandatory V3 execution preflight and final publication gates
obligations.observable_result: Controlled public-entry composition exercises owning checks and rejects an invalid V3 or final candidate despite prior admission
